case_name: Sonu Kanwar D/O Shri Chatar Singh vs State Of Rajasthan

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sonu Kanwar D/o Shri Chatar Singh & Anr.

facts_of_case: Petitioner No.1 is in 'live-in-relationship' with Petitioner No.2 against the wishes of her husband, Respondent No.7 and his family members. They are receiving threatening from them to their life and liberty.

legal_principles.principle: A person's willingness to part ways from a spouse is relevant in determining the nature of their relationship.
legal_principles.held: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that she is ready and willing to part her ways from the respondent No.7.

legal_principles.principle: A person's readiness to move forward with a divorce petition is relevant in determining the nature of their relationship.
legal_principles.held: He further submits that she is ready to move an application for divorce.

outcome.final_order: Interim order dated 28.02.2023 to continue till the next date. List the matter on 16.01.2024 as prayed jointly.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for police protection in a matrimonial dispute
advising on the legal implications of a live-in-relationship
assisting with a divorce petition and non-appearance
